verses.pali: Yo ca akappiye akappiyasaññī, yo ca kappiye kappiyasaññī.
verses.english: One who perceives what is unallowable as unallowable, and one who perceives what is allowable as allowable.

verses.pali: Imesaṁ kho, bhikkhave, dvinnaṁ āsavā na vaḍḍhantī”ti.
verses.english: These are the two whose defilements don’t grow.”
